chunks: And whatever is in it from Suwayd al-Qallāʾ, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah have mercy on him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār and al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Suwayd al-Qallāʾ.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Suwayd al-Qallāʾ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Suwayd al-Qallāʾ. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the source path for verification.
